{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify total number of rows
total_rows = len(df)
print("Total number of rows in dataset:", total_rows)

# Identify rows with invalid age (age < 0)
invalid_age_rows = df[df['customer_age'] < 0]
invalid_count = len(invalid_age_rows)
print("Number of rows with invalid age (age < 0):", invalid_count)

# Among them, how many are converted?
converted_invalid = invalid_age_rows[invalid_age_rows['converted'] == 1]
converted_invalid_count = len(converted_invalid)
print("Number of converted customers with invalid age (age < 0):", converted_invalid_count)

# Filter out invalid age rows
valid_df = df[df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Filter for converted customers in valid data
converted_customers_valid = valid_df[valid_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted_valid = converted_customers_valid['customer_age'].mean()
print("Mean age of converted customers (valid age):", mean_age_converted_valid)

# Number of converted customers with valid age
n_converted_valid = len(converted_customers_valid)
print("Number of converted customers with valid age:", n_converted_valid)"}
